## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changes.

## Validation

Include test results, affected platforms, and a workflow evaluation when instructions change.

- [ ] All repository content and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] Canonical skills and generated plugin files match.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, captured media, or private source are included.
- [ ] Capability, installation, and update claims match tested behavior.
- [ ] Main promotion comes from dev and preserves the long-lived dev branch.
